[shr-00001] When the task specifies an object must be under another object, first locate the second object, then check under it for the first object. Do not examine any visible instance of the first object unless its location relative to the second object has been confirmed.
[shr-00007] When the target object and the destination are both clearly visible and accessible, directly take and place the object without performing unnecessary intermediate checks.
[shr-00009] When a target object is clearly visible and accessible, avoid repeating examination actions unless new information is expected to appear (e.g., an object being revealed after an interaction).
## VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
[vc-00002] Before examining an object, verify that it is in the correct spatial relationship to the reference object specified in the task (e.g., 'under the desklamp').
[vc-00003] After locating the reference object (e.g., 'desklamp'), explicitly inspect under it for the target object (e.g., 'box') before proceeding with any interaction.
[vc-00004] When a target object is visible in another location, explicitly check under the reference object first to confirm the spatial relationship before interacting with the target object.
[vc-00005] When the reference object (e.g., 'desklamp') is located, explicitly perform an 'examine under' or 'look under' action to confirm the presence of the target object (e.g., 'box') in the specified spatial relationship.
[vc-00006] When a target object is visible in the environment, avoid interacting with it unless its location relative to the reference object has been explicitly confirmed through an 'examine under' or 'look under' action.
[vc-00008] After moving an object to its destination, explicitly verify that it is now located in the correct spatial relationship (e.g., 'on the sofa') by examining the destination object.
[vc-00010] After placing an object at its destination, explicitly verify that it is now located there by examining the destination object, even when no spatial relationship is specified.
[vc-00011] When no target object is found after multiple checks and all accessible locations have been examined, stop searching and conclude that the object is not available in the current environment.
